description: Use polygon boundaries as hard restrictions only for configured historic sites; school and park boundaries are advisories unless the matched OSM way has an explicit access restriction.
note: School and park boundaries are advisories, not route blockers. Hard rejection requires a mapped palace boundary or an OSM way matched to the route with an explicit no/private/customers/permit or foot=no/private/use_sidepath restriction. Missing access tags are not proof of physical public access.
